explanation: Built for the 1889 World's Fair, it had a 20-year permit. It was saved partly because it proved useful as a giant radio antenna.

claims.text: The Eiffel Tower was granted a permit to stand for 20 years.
The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 Exposition Universelle (World's Fair) in Paris.
The Eiffel Tower's value as a radio transmission antenna helped save it from demolition.
